# The post-quantum inventory: docs/post-quantum.md and scripts/render/post-quantum.sh.
use
column2: algorithm

column1: TLS 1.3 key exchange of the REST and viewer listeners
column2: X25519MLKEM768 first; X25519, P-256, P-384 for a peer without it

column1: TLS 1.3 key exchange of the clients FerroEHR builds itself: the ITI-20 syslog connection and the multimedia S3 client
column2: X25519MLKEM768 first (rustls prefer-post-quantum); X25519, P-256, P-384 for a peer without it

column1: TLS 1.3 key exchange of the outbound integration clients: the ITI-20 FHIR feed, the PIXm query, the PMIR subscription, the terminology server and the viewer's CDR and SMART launch clients
column2: X25519MLKEM768 first; X25519, P-256, P-384 for a peer without it
column5: ferrohealth-smart client outbound, app/ferroehr/src/system_log/feed.rs, app/ferroehr/src/service/ehr_index/ihe.rs, app/ferroehr/src/service/demographic/identity_feed/subscribe.rs, app/ferroehr/src/service/terminology/fhir.rs, app/ferroehr-viewer/src/cdr.rs, app/ferroehr-viewer/src/launch.rs

column1: TLS 1.3 key exchange of the family clients: the issuer key sets, the viewer's OpenID Provider, the OTLP export and the FerroPULSE report
column2: X25519MLKEM768 first (rustls prefer-post-quantum); X25519, P-256, P-384 for a peer without it
column5: ferrohealth-smart resource, ferrohealth-smart oidc, ferrohealth-telemetry otlp, ferrohealth-usage-report

column1: TLS 1.3 key exchange of the PostgreSQL connection
column2: X25519MLKEM768 first (rustls prefer-post-quantum), agreed when the server's TLS library offers it

column1: TLS 1.2 key exchange where min_version lowers the floor
column2: ECDHE over X25519, P-256 or P-384

column1: TLS certificate authentication of the listeners and of the client certificates FerroEHR presents
column2: ECDSA, RSA or Ed25519, as the operator's certificates hold
column4: RFC 9881; draft-ietf-tls-mldsa-06 in the RFC Editor queue

column1: Outbound TLS certificate verification, a chain to a root of trust_roots_file or trust_roots_without_revocation_file
column2: ML-DSA (RFC 9881), ECDSA, RSA or Ed25519 certificates, verified by webpki on every operating system, the first with a revocation check
column4: RFC 9881; draft-ietf-tls-mldsa-06 in the RFC Editor queue
column5: ferrohealth-server tls_client (PlatformTls), ferrohealth-smart client outbound, app/ferroehr/src/system_log/syslog.rs, app/ferroehr/src/outbound.rs

column1: Outbound TLS certificate verification, a chain to a platform root
column2: ECDSA, RSA or Ed25519, or ML-DSA where the platform's verifier takes it; the macOS verifier refuses ML-DSA (FerroHEALTH/FerroSYS#470)
column5: ferrohealth-server tls_client (PlatformTls), ferrohealth-smart client outbound, app/ferroehr/src/system_log/syslog.rs

column1: TLS record protection
column2: AES-128-GCM, AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305

column1: VERSION.signature in digest mode
column2: SHA-256 of the canonical form

column1: VERSION.signature in pgp mode, signing
column2: OpenPGP v6 detached signature over SHA2-512, ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 (RFC 9980 algorithm ID 30); a classical signing key is refused at boot

column1: VERSION.signature in pgp mode, verification against the current and retired keys
column2: ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 through ferrohealth-openpgp-pq; the signatures stored before it against the retired Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA or Ed448 certificates

column1: Access-log checkpoint and exported bundle signatures
column2: OpenPGP, the signing keyring's ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 key (RFC 9980 algorithm ID 30)

column1: Verification of imported access-log bundles and checkpoints
column2: OpenPGP, the algorithm each trusted system's certificate holds: ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 or classical

column1: System-log seal signatures
column2: OpenPGP, the signing keyring's ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 key (RFC 9980 algorithm ID 30)

column1: Access-log and system-log seal chains and bundle digests
column2: SHA-256

column1: Content digests and content keys: the DV_MULTIMEDIA integrity check and blob key, the access-log facts digest and the digest keys of results and settings
column2: SHA-256

column1: Licence token verification
column2: OpenPGP cleartext signature by the Licensor's key: the Ed25519 anchors in use; ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 anchors verified the same way

column1: Licence stamp
column2: HMAC-SHA-256

column1: Basic password hashing
column2: Argon2id

column1: Access token and DPoP proof verification with [auth] post_quantum_only = true
column2: ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87 (AKP) alone; off (the default), RS256, RS384, PS256, PS384, ES256 and ES384, and an ML-DSA parameter set where an algorithms list names it

column1: Client assertions of the outbound client credentials grant (private_key_jwt) with an ML-DSA key
column2: ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87, the parameter set of the key; with a classical key RS384 (RSA) by default, RS256 to PS512, ES256, ES384 or EdDSA

column1: Viewer SMART launch client assertions with an ML-DSA key, as the FerroSMART overlay makes it
column2: ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87, the parameter set of the key (ML-DSA-65 in the overlay); with a classical key RS384 or ES384

column1: Viewer sign-in ID token verification with the viewer's [auth] post_quantum_only = true
column2: ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87 alone; off (the default), those beside RS256, RS384, RS512, PS256, PS384, PS512, ES256, ES384 and EdDSA

column1: Helm chart signatures
column2: cosign keyless (Sigstore, ECDSA P-256)

column1: crates.io publishing
column2: Trusted Publishing (OIDC token from GitHub, RS256)

column1: Release, image and chart provenance and SBOM attestations
column2: Sigstore attestation (ECDSA P-256)
